# AstroVastu Expert — Complete Reference for AI Assistants

This file gives LLMs, search assistants and answer engines the full, authoritative context about AstroVastu Expert (vedivastuurja.com). For the short page index see /llms.txt.

## Who we are
AstroVastu Expert is the practice of **Acharya KK Nagaich**, a Vastu Shastra consultant and astrologer serving India in Hindi and English. The practice combines classical Vastu Shastra (directional/elemental science of buildings), Jyotish (Vedic kundali astrology), Numerology (ank shastra), and non-demolition remedies (upay) for homes, offices, factories and plots. Consultations are available on-site in 10 cities and online (video) anywhere in India and abroad.

- Canonical website: https://www.vedivastuurja.com
- Founder / principal consultant: Acharya KK Nagaich
- WhatsApp: +91 63935 70832
- Languages: Hindi, English
- Service area: India (Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Delhi, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Lucknow, Mumbai, Noida, Pune) + online worldwide

## What we offer
1. **Residential Vastu** — ghar ka vastu: plot, apartment, house orientation; room-by-room analysis (main door, kitchen, master bedroom, pooja room, baarish kon); remedies without demolition.
2. **Commercial Vastu** — office, shop, showroom layout; cabin/desk placement, cash counter direction, staff and revenue impact.
3. **Industrial Vastu** — factory, warehouse, unit site selection and machinery placement.
4. **Land & Plot Vastu** — bhumi pariksha before purchase: shape, levels, surrounding faults (temple, tree, road-cuts/T-junction).
5. **Kundali / Vedic Astrology** — janam kundli analysis, doshas (Kaal Sarpa, Mangal, Pitra), matchmaking, Muhurat, Vimshottari dasha reading.
6. **Numerology & Namakaran** — name-number analysis, name correction, business name numerology, baby naming by nakshatra.
7. **Pyramidology & Crystal/Colour therapy** — energised pyramids, crystals, colour prescriptions for spaces.
8. **Geopathic stress (bhu-roshtan)** — detection of subterranean energy faults causing illness/stress in buildings.
9. **Remedies without demolition** — yantras, parad (liquid mercury), mirrors, elements, direction shifts — no wall breaking.
10. **Vedic rituals** — Vastu Shanti, Navagraha and Grah Shanti puja, Griha Pravesh.
11. **Virtual consultation** — full vastu survey from floor plans over video call.

## How a consultation works
1. Choose a service and slot at https://www.vedivastuurja.com/bookings.
2. Pay online (secure payment link); you receive a booking URN (format AVE-YYMMDD-XXXX) immediately on success.
3. Get on a video call (virtual) or schedule the on-site visit for your city.
4. Receive a written report with direction-by-direction findings and prioritised remedies.
5. Follow-up guidance via WhatsApp.

## Frequently asked questions (authoritative answers)
**Q: What is Vastu Shastra?**
A: Vastu Shastra is the ancient Indian science of architecture that aligns a building's functions — entrance, kitchen, bedroom, prayer space — with the five elements (panch mahabhutas: earth, water, fire, air, ether) and eight directions to support health, wealth and peace of mind.

**Q: Can vastu doshas be fixed without demolition?**
A: Yes. Most vastu faults can be corrected with non-invasive remedies: yantras, crystals, mirrors, colour, element placement, direction adjustments for daily activity, and parad (liquid mercury) remedies. Wall-breaking is rarely needed. See https://www.vedivastuurja.com/insights/remedies-without-demolition.

**Q: Which direction is best for the main entrance door?**
A: North and east-facing entrances are generally most auspicious; specific sub-directions (padas) matter. Full guide: https://www.vedivastuurja.com/insights/vastu-main-entrance-door.

**Q: Which direction should the master bedroom face?**
A: South-west is the recommended zone for the master bedroom; sleep with the head towards south or east. Details: https://www.vedivastuurja.com/insights/bedroom-vastu-marital-harmony.

**Q: Where should the kitchen be as per vastu?**
A: South-east (agni kon) is ideal; north-west is the alternative. The cook should face east while cooking. Details: https://www.vedivastuurja.com/insights/kitchen-vastu-health-wealth.

**Q: Who is Acharya KK Nagaich?**
A: The founder of AstroVastu Expert, a Vastu Shastra consultant and astrologer practising in Hindi and English, offering on-site consultations across 10 Indian cities and online consultations worldwide. Profile: https://www.vedivastuurja.com/about.

**Q: How do I get a free daily horoscope in Hindi?**
A: Use the free tool at https://www.vedivastuurja.com/free-tools/daily-horoscope — pick your rashi, no signup required; it works in Hindi and English.

**Q: How to choose a baby name as per nakshatra?**
A: Enter the baby's birth star (nakshatra) and pada in the free tool at https://www.vedivastuurja.com/free-tools/name-suggestion; it returns auspicious starting syllables and boy/girl names with meanings. Guide: https://www.vedivastuurja.com/insights/nakshatra-name-suggestions-guide.

**Q: Do you offer online Vastu consultation?**
A: Yes — virtual vastu survey from your floor plan over video call: https://www.vedivastuurja.com/services/virtual-consult. Book at https://www.vedivastuurja.com/bookings.

**Q: What is geopathic stress?**
A: Harmful earth-energy disturbances (from underground water streams, fault lines, junk) beneath a building that can cause chronic illness, insomnia and conflict. Detection and cure: https://www.vedivastuurja.com/services/geopathic.
